description_en: Revokes a specified user’s retrieval access to a knowledge base
description_zh: 撤销指定用户的知识库检索权限
name: RevokeKnowledgeBaseRetrieval

parameters.help_en: The type of the principal that receives the share. This parameter is optional. If omitted, the default value is USER. Only USER is supported in the initial phase
parameters.help_zh: 接收分享的主体类型，可选，省略默认USER；首期仅支持USER
parameters.name: principal_type

parameters.help_en: The DataWorks user ID of the target user. This is neither the RAM UID nor the caller identity
parameters.help_zh: 目标用户的DataWorks UserId，不是RAM UID，也不是调用者身份
parameters.name: principal_id

Code.description_en: The business error code, which is used to determine the error type when the request fails
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码；请求失败时用于判断错误类型

Data.description_en: The business data returned when the request is successful
Data.description_zh: 成功时返回的业务数据

KnowledgeBaseId.description_en: The stable ID of the associated knowledge base
KnowledgeBaseId.description_zh: 所属知识库的稳定 ID

PrincipalId.description_en: The DataWorks user ID that receives the share. When a new user is added, the system verifies that the user is a member of the same tenant
PrincipalId.description_zh: 接收分享的 DataWorks UserId，新增时校验同租户成员

PrincipalType.description_en: The type of principal that receives the share. This field is optional in the request. The default and the only response value is USER
PrincipalType.description_zh: 接收分享的对象类型；请求可选，省略默认 USER；响应固定返回 USER

Message.description_en: The security error message returned when the request fails
Message.description_zh: 请求失败时的安全错误信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于定位问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
